description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) performance of different Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) models as a function of the number of queries used during inference, with the x-axis representing the number of queries (labeled "queries used during inference (S)") on a linear scale ranging from 2 to 8, and the y-axis showing the MRR@10 score on a linear scale from 33.5 to 36.0. The plot compares four models: "DPR w/o query" (black solid line), "DPR w/ corpus expansion" (red solid line with circular markers), "DPR w/ document expansion" (green solid line with triangular markers), and "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" (blue solid line with star markers). The black line remains relatively flat, with an MRR@10 value around 34.5. The red line starts at approximately 35.0 and steadily increases to about 36.0. The green line begins at roughly 34.5 and shows a gradual increase to around 35.8. The blue line starts at approximately 34.5, peaks near 35.5 at 4 queries, and then fluctuates slightly before ending at about 35.4.
